title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) activated off of IR, will play against Cleveland
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) has been activated from IR, clearing the way for him to return against Cleveland.
items.impact: Lane has been out since fracturing his wrist in Week 1, so it will be interesting to see what his snap counts and route shares look like after the IR stint. The team praised him all offseason and focused on him during his brief playing time in Week 1, so hopefully he will be able to find himself a decent role as the WR2 of the offense.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) starting for the Bears Sunday
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is the starter for the Bears on Sunday against the Falcons. After a few weeks' absence, the franchise QB is back.
items.impact: Williams was initially questionable to play, but the Bears are now planning on getting him back in the lineup after a week of practice where he took starter reps. It will be interesting to see Caleb in a more "regular" game and how it affects the pass catchers, who have only played with Caleb in one normal game, and even that "normal" game saw copious amounts of production from the running backs.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) placed on IR
items.desc: Jalen Hurts (blood clot) has been placed on IR due to a blood clot.
items.impact: At first the Eagles were not going to place him on IR, but after further consultations, they have decided to make that move. Tanner McKee will start in his place for at least the next four games, with Carolina on tap tomorrow. All the pass catchers will likely see a downtick in production, but should still be usable if McKee is halfway decent.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Freiermuth (calf) now questionable Sunday
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth has been added to the injury report as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Freiermuth was a late addition to the injury report with a calf injury. His status will need to be monitored Sunday morning.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: DK Metcalf is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) likely to be activated from IR on Saturday
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) is expected to be activated from IR on Saturday and play on Sunday against the Jets.
items.impact: After a four game stint on IR with an ankle sprain, it looks like Brown will return. The Patriots receiver room has been a revolving door of production, with Romeo Doubs, Kyle Williams, and Efton Chism all seeing some sort of success with AJB out. Browns return will likely put Williams and Chism back in limited roles, but Doubs should still she the field fairly consistently.
